verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not a cap-table or equity-management system. Automatically tracking Rule 701 thresholds and generating Form 3921 and 83(b) filings from a cap table is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude maintains a cap table or ships equity-compliance filing features, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
